verdict.rationale: Cactus's own pricing docs refer to 'the open-source package'. Public GitHub repos (cactus-compute/cactus, cactus-compute/needle) are cited with READMEs and build/install commands, which indicates readable source. However, no evidence names the actual license or confirms it covers the whole product, as opposed to only the local package. missing for 10: explicit named open license (e.g. LICENSE file/SPDX), confirmation of which components are open vs. platform-only, independent corroboration of license terms.

support.subject: As an AI-native user, I can read the product's source under an open license

citations.quote: Free: $0 for local LoRA fine-tuning with the open-source package.
